title: On the convergence of the normalized power sequence of Riesz operators
summary: Let $\mathscr{H}$ be a complex Hilbert space and $\mathscr{B}(\mathscr{H})$ be the algebra of all bounded linear operators on $\mathscr{H}$. For $T \in \mathscr{B}(\mathscr{H})$, let $|T| := (T^*T)^{\frac{1}{2}}$. We refer to the sequence $\big\{|T^n|^{\frac{1}{n}}\big\}_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ as the NPS (normalized power sequence) of $T$. In this article, we show that the NPS of a Riesz operator $R \in \mathscr{B}(\mathscr{H})$ converges in norm to a positive operator $H$, and provide an explicit description of the spectral resolution of $H$ in terms of the Riesz idempotents associated with…
